Runs counts the runs per setting. The baseline configuration ran once in each session, and Table~\ref{tab:platforms} gives the script of each session. The baseline configuration is also one setting of experiments 2, 3, 4, 6, 7, and 8. Alphabet and fixed are the repeated-alphabet and fixed sequences. Files are in \texttt{results/sweep/}, except those of the baseline runs in \texttt{results/}. All runs use \texttt{model\_3}, no recycling, and float32 parameters unless varied.
